segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Jesus sat on the hillside and taught the crowds a kind of love they had never heard before — not just for friends, but for enemies too.

segments.speaker: jesus
segments.text: But I say unto you, Love your enemies, bless them that curse you, do good to them that hate you, and pray for them which despitefully use you, and persecute you;

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Love your enemies, he said. Bless the ones who curse you. Do good to the ones who hate you, and pray for the people who use you badly. Not put up with them. Not stay out of their way. Love them, and mean it.

segments.speaker: jesus
segments.text: That ye may be the children of your Father which is in heaven: for he maketh his sun to rise on the evil and on the good, and sendeth rain on the just and on the unjust.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: The point was simple and hard at once — God's kindness falls on everyone, the grateful and the cruel alike.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Then he set the bar that no one could reach alone, and meant for us to run toward it.

segments.speaker: jesus
segments.text: Be ye therefore perfect, even as your Father which is in heaven is perfect.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Not perfect by comparison with each other. Perfect by the measure of a Father whose love has no edge, no favor, no limit.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: He asks for a love without limits — and he gives the grace to grow into it. Come and learn it from him.
